newsitem.title: USA: DowElanco, EPA set up insecticide use program.
newsitem.headline: DowElanco, EPA set up insecticide use program.

text.p: DowElanco, a joint venture between Dow Chemical Co and Eli Lilly and Co, said Wednesday it will establish a program with the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) to promote the safe use of its Dursban insecticide products.

DowElanco and the EPA plan to set up a 10-point program that includes creating a blue-ribbon scientific advisory panel and providing health information and emergency support through pest control centers.
Dursban is used in more than 20 million U.S. homes to rid residences of dangerous pests and bugs, DowElanco said.
